This is the new home of [ScreenToGif](http://www.screentogif.com). _A screen, webcam, and sketchboard recorder with an integrated editor._ ## 🔧 This App Can - Record your screen, webcam feed, or a sketchboard. - Edit and customize your recordings. - Export to gif, apng, webp, bpg, avi, mkv, mov, mp4, or webm. - Upload to Imgur, Gfycat, Giphy, Catbox and more. ## 🧱 Requirements ### To Use - Windows 10 or newer. - [.NET 8 Desktop Runtime](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/8.0/runtime) (if using the dotnet dependent version). - [FFmpeg](https://www.screentogif.com/ffmpeg-location) (if using FFmpeg to encode, recommended). - [Gifski](https://www.screentogif.com/gifski-location) (if using Gifski to encode, recommended). ### To Build - Visual Studio 2022 Community with `.NET desktop development` components. ## 🔬 Documentation All user documentation can be found at the website: - [Main page with download links](https://www.screentogif.com/) - [Frequently asked questions](https://www.screentogif.com/faq) - [Help and troubleshooting](https://www.screentogif.com/help) - [Share ideas and vote](https://www.screentogif.com/share) - [Source code](https://www.screentogif.com/source) ## 🧾 Mentions > Originally imagined and developed by myself, [Nicke Project Structure ``` screentogif-tauri/ ├── src/ # React frontend │ ├── components/ # React components │ ├── hooks/ # Custom React hooks │ ├── styles/ # CSS styles │ └── lib/ # Utility functions ├──
